name: TRUTH ABOUT USA || BEHTI NAAK|| Ft. Anu Menon, Kumar Varun
description:
Behtis class teacher tells Behti that she has received a scholarship? That's wonderful news! Or is it?

Behti Naak is a 10-year-old girl, daughter of Atul Naak and Alka Naak and her best friend is Shikhar. She minds her business until someone messes with her. 

Created and Written by- Sumukhi Suresh
